releaseName: Your progress bar now measures the balance
notes: Your Debt-Free Progress percentage may change after this update. Nothing has been lost and no payment has been forgotten — the number was being worked out the wrong way and is now correct.
It used to add up every dollar you had paid, interest included, and compare that to what you started owing. On a high-rate balance that reads far higher than the debt has actually fallen.
It now measures how much of your starting balance is gone, so the bar, the share card and your badges agree with the progress shown on each individual debt.
The total you have paid in is still there on the Wins tab, labelled as payments made.
